prompts.scenes:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW production scene atlas for original Arabic social deduction game Mafia Maydan. The attached original Maydan atlas is ONLY a palette/material/style reference, not the target to overwrite. This new atlas is a precisely rectangular grid of TWO columns and FOUR rows, EIGHT landscape panels, each panel 16:9. Total canvas ratio 8:9, ideally 1536x1728. All cells identical, exactly aligned, zero borders, zero gutters, full bleed, nothing crosses a cell boundary. Premium original contemporary Levantine noir, cinematic graphic-novel illustration, tactile stone and dark walnut, black/navy, antique brass amber lamps, subtle plum and teal shadows. Readable focal subjects on small phones; atmospheric but clear silhouettes. NO TEXT, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, blood, weapons, violence, faction emblems or identifiable player roles. Neutral public scenes suitable regardless of secret roles.
Exact cell order LEFT TO RIGHT:
ROW1: NIGHT: panoramic empty Levantine stone alley at midnight, moon and warm lantern, no person. DAWN: quiet same town's stone roofs/archway in soft peach dawn, no people.
ROW2: INVESTIGATION: landscape close view of anonymous unmarked papers and magnifying glass on detective desk, warm lamplight, no faces or readable evidence. ELIMINATION: one EMPTY plain chair pulled back from council table and one lamp dimmed, no hat or character-specific object, symbolic absence without showing role or team.
ROW3: VERDICT: closed carved walnut ballot box with a folded plain slip entering, hand in neutral sleeve, no outcome shown. ENDING: quiet empty council table with opened blank envelopes, calm morning light through an archway, neutral between winners.
ROW4: DEAL: eight identical CLOSED midnight-blue envelopes with plain round brass wax seals on a dark council table, assignment mystery, no role or faction marks. LOBBY: welcoming but mysterious empty noir council room with eight chairs around a table, subdued warm lamps and dark teal ambience.
Each picture framed wide with subject centered and visible within its own 16:9 panel. Do not make square panels. Do not reuse the hat from old elimination scene. Original artwork only.
prompts.cardBack: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original face-down playing card texture for Mafia Maydan, Arabic social deduction mobile game. Vertical 3:4 canvas entirely occupied by the flat front-facing card back, NO perspective, NO scene, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO question mark, NO silhouette or role symbol, NO faction marks. A premium ink-navy embossed leather surface with a narrow antique-brass double border, rounded inner corners, extremely restrained fine Levantine geometric filigree only at corners. In the center one clean geometric eight-point ornamental star engraved in muted brass, identical rotational symmetry, dark teal soft inner highlights. Dark plum/navy shadows and tactile engraving create subtle depth, crisp at a tiny 56px size. Neutral to all teams, mysterious and dignified, original art, no known game or brand design. High contrast border but quiet center, no glare, no glowing neon. The entire rectangular image is the card design, not a card photographed on a background.
